lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Subject 7. Still breathing.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Mera.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: You should be dead three times over. Dominion burns through purged operatives like fuel. But here you stand.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: That makes you either the most durable artifact they ever built, or the one they all need dead the most. Both possibilities are lucrative.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Mera. Took your time finding your way back to us.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Kessler. Still moving cargo for the lost?

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: I have the access codes for Tier 3 of the Iron Sepulcher. Your sealed file is logged there as SUBJECT 7. Has been since your purge.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: But the price is not currency. I enter with you. I read the file at the same moment you do.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's not protocol for a retrieval. That's leverage.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Old habits. The Lotus fenced pieces of his mind once, before I knew whose they were. I owe him my own eyes on the whole of it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I accept.

lines.speaker: Station Control
lines.text: Unauthorized vessels! Power down immediately or we burn you!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Engines to full! Now!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Two minutes of fire to clear them.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Third is breaking pursuit!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: They know our heading now. The Sepulcher's location is already logged.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Then we move fast.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: The Sepulcher is a tomb for classified files. Operative memories. Purge records. Things the Dominion does not want circulating.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: No conventional docking. We breach through the thermal exhaust maintenance lock. Ninety-second spoofed signature window before every alarm in the station goes active.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: And if we miss the window?

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Then we burn to cinder and the file stays buried.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Your file is locked in Tier 3. The deepest vault level. The only way to stop your neural purge is to reach the edit console and delete the killswitch protocol from the archive record directly. If the Dominion's remote trigger has no reference to activate, it severs the link to your chip.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: And if the deletion does not work?

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Then you are still dying. Just slower now. Without anyone on the other end of the trigger ordering it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: That is enough.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Signature spoof is active. Window is now.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Weapons lock! Evasive!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Four seconds to the lock.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Cipher. Welcome to the Sepulcher.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I have been expecting this approach for six cycles. The vault is sealed ahead of you.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Read what is there. Then decide if you still want to keep surviving.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Move fast.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: You're three corridors from Tier 3. Left at the main junction. The cryogenic chamber is beyond the secondary bulkhead.

lines.speaker: Khall (Hologram)
lines.text: You were the only operative I believed could understand what the Dominion actually was.

lines.speaker: Khall (Hologram)
lines.text: The orphanage test was designed to break your conditioning. To see if the Program's mercy could fracture under pressure.

lines.speaker: Khall (Hologram)
lines.text: When it did not break, when you chose to refuse, I knew what you were.

lines.speaker: Khall (Hologram)
lines.text: I armed the killswitch as ordered. But I made certain you survived anyway. Because I was not ready to accept what your refusal meant.

lines.speaker: Khall (Hologram)
lines.text: I do not expect forgiveness. I expect you to understand that I was trapped in the same cage you are escaping.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: You're clear. The vault is ahead.

lines.speaker: Cipher (Recording - Younger)
lines.text: My name is Soren. I chose to stop.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My name is Soren.

lines.speaker: Katana (Interior VO)
lines.text: Soren. Yes. I have kept it for you since before the wipe. Take it back. Take everything back.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Now! Go!

lines.speaker: Broker (Hollow Kings)
lines.text: Operative Cipher. A name has cleared from the Dominion's purged list. Remarkable.

lines.speaker: Broker (Hollow Kings)
lines.text: We offer one transaction. Scrub all Dominion server records of the Sepulcher vault heist. Delete every trace of what occurred in Tier 3.

lines.speaker: Broker (Hollow Kings)
lines.text: In exchange, you take one contract. Small retrieval. Classified location. One target. Alive.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I did not come this far to trade one leash for another.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The Carnival's ledgers said the stolen shards of my memory moved through Lotus hands before Morrigan bought them back. Your hands, Mera?

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Then we are even on the subject of things neither of us will explain.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: That is acceptable.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Contact closing! Weapons hot!

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: We are clear.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The killswitch is confirmed gone. The remote trigger is severed.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The neural purge has stopped.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: But the diagnostic is showing something else.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Deeper in the architecture. Below the purge systems. A second layer. Older. It has different construction patterns.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: A time-lock. Dormant. Structured completely differently from the killswitch. It did not activate when the remote trigger died.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: It is still waiting. Timing toward something none of us can identify.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Tessa Rin would need to see this. Even then I do not know how fast she could answer.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: That architecture is not Khall's. It is older than him.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: That is foundational Dominion work. Oldest generation.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The killswitch is gone. The remote trigger is severed. The neural purge has stopped.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: But there is another layer. Older. Deeper. Still armed.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Whatever the time-lock holds, I carry it forward now knowing who I am.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I am Soren. Not a designation handed down. Not a codename. Mine, from before all the conditioning and the purge and the years of not knowing.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We breached the Iron Sepulcher, the Dominion's black-archive, anchored in a dead nebula at the galaxy's cold rim. Mera Voss came back for this, trading her access codes for her own eyes on my file. Inside Tier 3, the vault opened my sealed record: SUBJECT 7. And underneath the designation was a name I was never supposed to hear again. I deleted the killswitch protocol from the archive. The remote trigger is severed. The neural purge has gone quiet. I have my name back. I am Soren.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: But the diagnostic found something underneath all of it. A second layer in your chip, older than the killswitch, built differently, dormant. A time-lock. It did not die when the trigger did. It is still counting toward something none of us can read, and Mera says that architecture is older than Khall, foundational Dominion work, oldest generation. So we are not finished. Whatever they buried deepest in you is still armed, and we need to find what it is waiting for before it finds us.
